Definition
[Weak solution of the Hamilton--Jacobi initial-value problem] ↗ def:semiconcave-function 1. ch3:3.3.3-def-3\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

A Lipschitz $u:\R ^n\times [0,\infty )\to \R $ is a weak solution if

  1. $u(x,0)=g(x)$;

  2. $u_t+H(Du)=0$ almost everywhere for $t>0$;

  3. $u(x+z,t)-2u(x,t)+u(x-z,t)\le C(1+t^{-1})|z|^2$.
